evidence: Donatus, Ars minor, Dē verbō: praeteritum inperfectum, ut legēbam
terms.comment: The unfinished past: legēbam, I was reading, used to read. Donatus (fourth century) lists five tenses for conjugating a verb: praesēns, praeteritum inperfectum, praeteritum perfectum, praeteritum plūsquamperfectum, futūrum. The schools shorten it to imperfectum. Lewis & Short has no entry for the tense name. In the imperfect tense: tempore praeteritō imperfectō (Traupman 246).

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency (printed page numbers): p. 226, p. 227, p. 246.
